body:
This stage asks whether the frozen R154/R156 proof-only inventory enhancement E+ adds enough complete-algorithm value beyond stable GI-TBC/B to become the paper's main method, and consolidates the mathematical and experimental lessons of R138–162 into the maintained manuscript.

All **18/18** prepaid, serial B/E+/cold P-GRB arms finish on the six preregistered prospective configurations. Each uses the same frozen R162 C++ executable and Gurobi 13.0.2, Seed0/Threads1, its own paid startup and, for E+, its own unchanged historical Python RN16384 helper. No new algorithm core, extra Seed, budget grid or old difficult-role rerun is introduced. Noncandidate R138–162 mechanisms remain off.

**Recommendation: retain B as paper main, with E+ as a limited, uniformly defined proof supplement.** B and E+ each certify 3/6; P certifies 1/6. B/E+ have identical physical U on all six configurations. E+ raises final proof L on X35 from .3949882559151472 to .42319954961578576, reducing the original gap from 13.6591% to 7.49238%. This is a real proof gain; the slightly weaker E+ raw search L is retained separately. The other five final proof endpoints are equal. E+ creates no new certificate and pays more time on all three jointly certified configurations (ratios 1.13067, 1.33574 and 1.05159). Its aggregate audit-inclusive cost is 55.1124s higher than B, about .74%; helper time is already included. Uniform E+ is explicitly considered as a reasonable alternative with this finite tradeoff, rather than rejected for failing to improve every case.

B/E+ each have lower U than P on three configurations, higher U on one and equal U on two. The C35 surplus configuration is the material opposing witness: P obtains U=.09331934374779818 versus B/E+ .12956638965196035. All 18 endpoints and OPEN results remain visible; conditional certificate-time comparisons do not become whole-panel speed claims.

These are **new configurations on archived CITI/CABI/DIVVY sources**, with deterministic synthetic inventory/demand/weight fields and one Seed. They are neither new-city external validation nor IID/factorial evidence. All six first valid draws were retained, with no redraw, historical base/configuration collision or within-source overlap between the new size roles. Recipe, inputs, canonical history-manifest keys and commands were committed before formal performance. The additional detailed master-row-to-input crosswalk was inspected after the first arm started and completed in the final readback; this ordering deviation is disclosed rather than described as preregistered. It changes no input, algorithm or outcome.

The maintained R137 body, mathematical analysis and supplement now connect physical/integer equivalence, epigraph-interval inventory objectives, conditional domain relations, cutoff/union proof composition and the separate evidence levels from point separation to prospective complete-method confirmation. Positive historical results and finite negative results retain their source identities. No TeX is changed and no refreshed PDF is claimed. Exactly one next question is retained for exposed C35's incumbent deficit; the existing R96 whole-fixed-order formulation is identified as prior art, and its reuse/reconciliation and whole-domain certification are prerequisites. No next-stage solve is launched.

Validation includes original full-fleet objective replay for all 18, proof/scope/coverage qualification, actual argv/PE/DLL/OS binding, cold P NumStart=0, self-paid H/helper, original compact references and closed failure costs. Three fresh independent agents close the math/method, execution/data+CSV and stage-direction review lines; they are agents, not independent human reviewers. Two actual GB18030 master CSVs each advance **85→91 rows**, adding only six qualified B/P pairs and preserving the old byte prefix, schema and encoding. E+ is not relabelled as GI-TBC.

Closed scientific cost is **24697.709828344174 / 72000 seconds (6.860475h)**, including necessary checks and preserved failed adapters. Packaging and public transport I/O are reported separately. The single new-only carrier contains **39888556 bytes / 50601 indexed members**; it includes no old raw archives, commercial runtime, licenses or credentials. Bounded anonymous byte/member recovery and current-only metadata screening will be recorded in the final delivery metadata; this is not a licensed semantic/performance rerun.

Fresh readback confirms main remains b2b940c1e517a72e226ec60fc49ff19651737632 and R162 #224 remains Open Draft/unmerged at faa22ce4804f925081fd05322262b4f7261db51f. This PR therefore stacks on **codex/round162-physical-g-completion**. Stable released defaults are unchanged; no predecessor is merged, no force push is used and no historical evidence is deleted.
